Identify the person who was appointed as Dictator for Andhra region to conduct Salt Satyagraha
x:
During the Salt Satyagraha (1930), Konda Venkatappayya was appointed as the "Dictator" (chief organizer) for Andhra by the Indian National Congress. He coordinated civil disobedience activities, mobilized volunteers and organized salt law violations across Andhra. His leadership greatly strengthened the Salt Satyagraha in the Telugu-speaking region.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
